title: Countertops
seoDescription: Granite, quartz and marble countertops in Newington, CT — design guidance, carefully selected materials and professional installation from Kitchen & Flooring Depot.

hero.body: From classic to contemporary, we help you find the perfect countertop to fit your style, your home and the way you live.

image.alt: Bright kitchen with a large stone island countertop and pendant lighting

benefits.title: Design guidance
benefits.body: Work with our team to choose a surface that fits your kitchen and daily routine.

benefits.title: Carefully selected materials
benefits.body: Explore granite, quartz and marble options available through our Newington showroom.

benefits.title: Professional installation
benefits.body: We can install the countertops you select as part of a complete kitchen solution.

materials.heading: Find your perfect surface.
materials.body: Choose from popular countertop materials for kitchens and baths — each with its own look, feel and care considerations.

items.title: Quartz
items.body: Engineered surfaces with a wide range of colors and patterns, valued for a non-porous, easy-to-maintain finish.

image.alt: Countertop surface detail on a kitchen island — inspiration photography

detail.heading: Quartz countertops
detail.body: Quartz offers consistent patterns and a non-porous surface that combines beauty with practicality for everyday kitchens. Care needs differ from natural stone — we’ll help you choose the right option for your home.

items.title: Granite
items.body: Natural stone with distinctive movement and durability for kitchens that see everyday use.

image.alt: Countertop surface on a kitchen island — inspiration photography

detail.heading: Granite countertops
detail.body: Granite brings natural variation and lasting strength. Our team can help you compare finishes and care needs so the surface fits how you cook and clean.

items.title: Marble
items.body: Classic stone with soft veining for a refined look in kitchens and baths.

image.alt: Close countertop surface detail — inspiration photography

detail.heading: Marble countertops
detail.body: Marble delivers timeless character. Care needs can differ from engineered surfaces — we’ll explain everyday cleaning that fits the material you choose.

feature.body: We help you select surfaces that suit your style and how you use your kitchen — then install them as part of a complete, thoughtfully planned space.
